metadata.name: sooth_launchpad
metadata.description: Sooth Protocol launchpad program — market factory, fee router, LP mint (LaunchpadEngine + FeeRouter port)

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Create a tradeable market in one transaction by composing the four
init legs from `sooth_market` + `sooth_amm` via CPI. STUB — body is
`todo!()` until the CPI plumbing lands. Architecture §4.1 has the
full call chain; the Accounts struct below already mirrors the union
of the four leg's account lists so the IDL-shape is committed.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global protocol config. Read-only here — used to (a) enforce
`creator == config.authority` if the cluster is in "permissioned"
mode, and (b) source the `default_trial_period` when leg 4 computes
`trial_end_at`. Architecture §9.

accounts.name: market
docs: New Market PDA. Owned by `sooth_market`; the CPI in leg 1 will `init`
it. UncheckedAccount here — the CPI handler does the real Anchor
validation. CHECK: derived via seeds + initialized by inner program.

accounts.name: adjudicator_allowlist
docs: Singleton allowlist of permitted adjudicator pubkeys. Read-only here;
the inner `initialize_market` handler verifies `args.adjudicator` is
present (Codex C2 minimum-viable mitigation). The PDA must already
have been bootstrapped via `sooth_market::initialize_adjudicator_allowlist`
before any `create_market` call lands.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: outcome mints. Inner CPI re-asserts.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint. Pinned at `address = sooth_market::USDC_MINT_DEVNET` so
the canonical-USDC chain is unforgeable from the IDL surface alone
(mirrors the H1 fix on `initialize_market_vaults`). The inner CPI
re-asserts the same constraint.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Creator + payer for every leg. Each CPI re-checks
`signer == market.creator` so we don't need to pin it here.

instructions.name: distribute_fees
docs: Drain the global fee_pool_vault USDC ATA and split the proceeds
across the four destinations (bBase, LP yield, adjudicator, protocol
treasury) per architecture §8. The 4-way bps split is read from
ProtocolConfig; floor div with remainder-to-protocol mirrors EVM
_distributePostGrad. See programs/sooth_launchpad/src/instructions/
distribute_fees.rs for the pool-then-distribute design rationale.

accounts.name: fee_pool_authority
docs: Signer-only PDA — authority on the global fee_pool_vault. Owned
by sooth_launchpad. Seeds [b"fee_pool_authority"].

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint reference. Pinned to canonical USDC so all four
downstream token::mint checks transitively bind.

accounts.name: fee_pool_vault
docs: Global fee-pool ATA — owner = fee_pool_authority. Source of all
four transfers.

accounts.name: b_base_yield_vault
docs: bBase fee destination. ATA whose owner pubkey is left to the v1
integrator (e.g. a per-market seed_lp PDA, or the protocol
treasury for now). Mint is canonical USDC.

accounts.name: lp_yield_vault
docs: LP-yield ATA. Owned by the LP-yield PDA (out of scope here; the
owner check is enforced when seed_lp lands and binds the PDA).

accounts.name: adjudicator_fee_vault
docs: Adjudicator-fee ATA. v1 caveat: with a global pool we lose
per-market adjudicator attribution — the deposited slice is the
aggregate over all markets. Re-derivable from PositionTraded
events + configured fee_bps via the indexer.

accounts.name: protocol_treasury_vault
docs: Protocol treasury ATA. Pinned to config.treasury.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone can crank fee distribution — it's a pure split with no
authority gate. (EVM FeeRouter._distribute is external and
permissionless.)

instructions.name: initialize_fee_pool
docs: Bootstrap the singleton global fee_pool_vault USDC ATA. Single-shot
— must be called exactly once per cluster deploy. The ATA is owned
by the fee_pool_authority PDA (seeds [b"fee_pool_authority"]) and
consumed by sooth_amm::trade_positions / sell_positions (push side)
and sooth_launchpad::distribute_fees (drain side). Rent paid by
signer; no authority gate.

accounts.name: fee_pool_authority
docs: Signer-only PDA — the authority on the global fee_pool_vault.
Seeds [b"fee_pool_authority"].

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint reference. Pinned to canonical USDC so the ATA derives
off the same address trade_positions / distribute_fees expect.

accounts.name: fee_pool_vault
docs: Global fee-pool ATA — owner = fee_pool_authority. Created here
via the associated_token init constraint.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Pays the rent-exempt deposit for the ATA. Permissionless — any
wallet may front the rent.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Initialize the global `ProtocolConfig` PDA. **Single-shot**: must be
called exactly once per cluster deploy by the protocol authority. Seeds
`[b"protocol_config"]`. The `signer` becomes `config.authority` and is
the only key that can rotate fee bps / treasury later (those setters
are out-of-scope for this scaffold; see the comment in
`instructions/initialize_protocol.rs`).
EVM analogue: `LaunchpadEngine` constructor + `setDefaultTrialPeriod`
/ `setInvalidationBuffer` setters collapsed.

accounts.name: config
docs: New `ProtocolConfig` singleton. `init` (not `init_if_needed`) — re-init
must be impossible. Seeds have no entropy, so the second caller hits
`account already in use` from the runtime.

instructions.name: seed_lp
docs: Mint LP tokens for a creator's seed deposit on a pre-graduation market.
EVM analogue: `LaunchpadEngine._mintLPTokens` (private, called from
`createMarket`). On Solana the LP-mint step is hoisted to its own ix
because the `LpMint` PDA needs `init` codegen which would push
`create_market`'s `try_accounts` frame past the SBF 4 KB ceiling (same
constraint that fragmented `sooth_market::initialize_market`). STUB —
body is `todo!()`.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market PDA — owned by `sooth_market`. Read-only.

accounts.name: amm_state
docs: AmmState PDA — read `is_graduated` only.

accounts.name: lp_mint
docs: LP token mint owned by the launchpad. CHECK: PDA derived via seeds;
init'd by the handler body via manual `create_account` +
`initialize_mint` (Anchor's `init` constraint codegen overflows the
SBF 4 KB stack frame for this Accounts struct — see module comment).

accounts.name: lp_mint_authority
docs: Per-market signer-only PDA. The mint authority on `lp_mint`.
Seeds `[b"lp_mint_authority", market_id]` keep the authority
isolated per market — same pattern as `sooth_market::vault_authority`
/ `lock_authority`. CHECK: derived via seeds; signs the `mint_to`
CPI in the handler body.

accounts.name: creator_lp_ata
docs: Creator's LP-token ATA — destination of the `mint_to` CPI. CHECK:
derived via the standard spl-associated-token derivation; init'd
manually in the body.

accounts.name: lp_position
docs: Per-(creator, market) LP position record. CHECK: PDA derived via
seeds; init'd manually in the body for the same SBF-stack reason as
`lp_mint`.

instructions.name: mint_lp_for_buy
docs: PDA-signed LP-token mint helper for the AMM buy path. CPI'd into
by sooth_amm::trade_positions on every pre-graduation buy to credit
the trader's LP ATA with `amount` LP base units (1:1 with the
fee_usdc paid on the trade). Auth: parent-ix introspection requires
the calling top-level ix be a sooth_amm::trade_positions dispatch.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market PDA — owned by sooth_market. Read-only.

accounts.name: lp_mint
docs: Per-market LP token mint. Mut for mint_to.

accounts.name: lp_mint_authority
docs: Per-market signer-only PDA. Mint authority on lp_mint.

accounts.name: user_lp_ata
docs: User's LP-token ATA — destination of the mint_to CPI.

accounts.name: position
docs: Per-(user, market) Position from sooth_amm. Owner + PDA
derivation are validated in the handler.

accounts.name: instruction_sysvar
docs: Instructions sysvar — read by the parent-ix introspection check.

fields.name: market
docs: Backlink to the market PDA (parity with EVM addressing).

fields.name: q_yes
docs: Outstanding YES shares in WAD. Signed because intermediate `q + Δ` can
dip during multi-leg trades (see architecture §4.2).

fields.name: q_no
docs: Outstanding NO shares in WAD.

fields.name: b
docs: LMSR liquidity parameter in WAD. > 0 by invariant.

fields.name: seed_q_yes
docs: Initial seed liquidity (creator deposit). Used by the dismiss/refund
flow per architecture §9.

fields.name: fee_b_base_wad
docs: Accumulator for the bBase fee leg (50% pre-graduation per §8).
In WAD; CPI'd out to the fee router after graduation.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Deterministic 16-byte id (truncated keccak256 of question || creator
|| nonce). Architecture §2.2. Same field as
`sooth_market::InitializeMarketArgs::market_id` — passed through to
leg 1.

fields.name: adjudicator
docs: Adjudicator program id. Forwarded to leg 1
(`sooth_market::initialize_market`).

fields.name: initial_b
docs: Initial LMSR liquidity `b` in WAD. Forwarded to leg 4
(`sooth_amm::initialize_amm_state`).

types.name: FeesCollected
docs: Mirror of EVM `FeeRouter.FeesDistributed`. Emitted by `distribute_fees`
when the accumulator drains to the four destinations (architecture §8).

fields.name: total_wad
docs: Total fees moved out of `AmmState.fee_b_base_wad` in this call (WAD).

fields.name: to_b_base
docs: Slice routed to the bBase LP-yield ATA.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Total per-trade fee in basis points. Bounded ≤ 10_000 (100%).

fields.name: treasury
docs: USDC ATA where protocol's slice of fees lands. Must be non-default.

fields.name: b_base_share_bps
docs: 4-way fee split bps. Must sum to 10_000.

fields.name: default_trial_period
docs: Default trial period in seconds. EVM analogue: `defaultTrialPeriod` on
`LaunchpadEngine`. The concrete `trial_end_at` per-market is computed
in `create_market` (architecture §9).

types.name: LpPosition
docs: Per-(creator, market) LP claim record. Created by `seed_lp` via
manual `system_instruction::create_account` + Borsh serialise
(no Anchor `init` codegen — see seed_lp module comment for the
BPF stack-frame rationale). Mirrors the `MarketState` struct in
EVM `LaunchpadEngine`; the LP token itself is a separate SPL Mint
at `[b"lp", market_id]` with mint authority = `lp_mint_authority`.

fields.name: market
docs: Backlink to the market PDA.

fields.name: creator
docs: Pubkey of the creator. Equal to `market.creator`.

fields.name: lp_mint
docs: LP-token mint at `[b"lp", market_id]`.

fields.name: seed_deposit_wad
docs: Creator's seed deposit in WAD, bookkeeping only. Equals
`b_base * ln(2)` per EVM `LaunchpadEngine.MIN_DEPOSIT_WAD`.

fields.name: graduated_at
docs: Unix seconds at which the market graduated. 0 = not graduated.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for this PDA. Seeds `[b"lp_position", market_id, creator]`.

types.name: LpSeeded
docs: Emitted by `seed_lp` after the per-market `LpMint` + creator
`LpPosition` PDA + creator's LP ATA are bootstrapped and seeded
with the initial `lp_amount` allocation. Mirror of EVM
`LaunchpadEngine.LPTokenCreated` (`LaunchpadEngine.sol:446`)
plus the implicit `LaunchpadLPToken.Transfer(0, creator, depositWad)`
event from the OZ ERC20 base — collapsed into a single Solana log.

fields.name: market
docs: Market PDA the LP mint is scoped to.

fields.name: creator
docs: Creator who bootstrapped the LP position. Equal to `market.creator`.

fields.name: lp_mint
docs: New SPL Mint at `[b"lp", market_id]` — owned by the SPL token
program with mint authority = `lp_mint_authority` PDA.

fields.name: creator_lp_ata
docs: Creator's freshly-init'd LP-token ATA — destination of the seed
`mint_to`.

fields.name: lp_amount
docs: LP base units minted to `creator_lp_ata` — equals `args.lp_amount`.

fields.name: seed_deposit_wad
docs: Creator's seed deposit in WAD recorded on the new `LpPosition`
PDA. Used by the dismiss/refund flow (architecture §9).

fields.name: market_id
docs: Deterministic id derived from `keccak256(question || creator || nonce)`,
truncated to 16 bytes per architecture §2.2. Seed for every per-market
PDA in the protocol — see module comment.

fields.name: adjudicator
docs: Adjudicator program id. The adjudicator-CPI auth check on `lock` /
`settle` will validate the caller's program against this.

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC ATA owned by `vault_authority` PDA. All collateral for this market.

fields.name: lock_vault
docs: USDC ATA owned by `lock_authority` PDA. AMM lock-on-sell escrow.

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: Resolved outcome, valid only when `lifecycle == Settled`.
0 = NO, 1 = YES, 2 = INVALID per protocol-wide OUTCOME encoding.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for the `Market` PDA itself.

fields.name: vault_authority_bump
docs: Bump for the `vault_authority` signer PDA.

fields.name: lock_authority_bump
docs: Bump for the `lock_authority` signer PDA.

fields.name: yes_mint_bump
docs: Bump for `yes_mint` PDA.

fields.name: no_mint_bump
docs: Bump for `no_mint` PDA.

types.name: MarketCreated
docs: Mirror of EVM `LaunchpadEngine.MarketCreated`. Emitted by `create_market`
after the four CPI legs land (architecture §4.1).

fields.name: initial_b
docs: Initial LMSR liquidity `b` in WAD. Stored on `AmmState` after ix4.

fields.name: authority
docs: Pubkey allowed to call setters. Equals `creator` of the
`initialize_protocol` ix. Rotation is intentionally **not** wired in
this scaffold — when it lands, gate it on a 2/N multisig per the
security checklist.

fields.name: treasury
docs: USDC ATA where the protocol's slice of every fee distribution lands.
Validated non-default at init.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Total fee taken on each trade, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). EVM's
`preGradFeeBps` and `postGradFeeBps` collapse to a single field for
the v1 surface; the pre/post split lives on `AmmState.is_graduated`
and the *destinations* split (below) handles the difference.

fields.name: b_base_share_bps
docs: 4-way split bps — must sum to 10_000. Architecture §8.

fields.name: default_trial_period
docs: Default trial period in seconds. Mirrors EVM `defaultTrialPeriod`. The
concrete `trial_end_at` is computed per-market in `create_market` per
architecture §9: `min(0.3 × (deadline - now), default_trial_period)`.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for the singleton PDA.

types.name: ProtocolInitialized
docs: Emitted once per protocol deploy by `initialize_protocol`. Indexers can
pin the cluster's authority + treasury without re-reading the PDA.

fields.name: lp_amount
docs: LP-token base units to mint to `creator_lp_ata`. Pre-graduation 1:1
with the creator's USDC seed deposit (EVM convention; revisit when we
land an explicit LP price model).

fields.name: seed_deposit_wad
docs: Creator's seed deposit in WAD, recorded on `LpPosition` for the
dismiss/refund flow (architecture §9).
